title: 第5章 无间道与反无间道第6章 被忽悠去真武道场求援
slug: 西游反正很无聊随便打个劫呗
lines: 孙悟空不知道他这些小动作，都被楚云看在眼里。
两人境界差距太大。
孙悟空一来到山寨附近。
便被楚云发现了。
看到了孙悟空变做的小喽啰，一脸谄媚的走了进来。
和之前的小六子。
没有一点的区别。
看样子这种事情，以前孙悟空没有少干。
“今天是准备了什么宵夜？”
楚云抬眼皮看了一眼孙悟空问道。
“大王今天可是烧鸡，老白干！”
这些百姓的寻常酒肉孙悟空还是认识的。
“放下吧！”
孙悟空将夜宵放下，然后搓了搓手，一脸堆笑的问道。
“大王，您身手这么好，是师从何派啊？”
虽然在南瞻部洲修仙门派并不多见。
但是在东胜神洲，大大小小的修仙宗门数以万计。
楚云撕下鸡腿，狠狠的咬了一口。
这猴子明摆是要套套话。
既然你敢问，我就敢说。
“你可知在东胜神洲有一强大门派，名曰青玄宗！”
青玄宗？
别说孙悟空还真知道这个门派。
在天界时，孙悟空听说过，真武大帝在人间的道场就是青玄宗。
只是宗门有令，宗门弟子不得擅自离开东胜神洲。
所以南瞻部洲和西牛贺洲的青玄宗修仙者并不多。
“原来大王您是来自于青玄宗的修仙者？那……”
孙悟空刚想问真武大帝岂不是您的祖师爷。
不过他瞬间意识到，他现在的身份不过是一个小毛贼而已。
哪里会知道真武大帝？
“那什么？”
楚云询问道。
“我是说那大王能不能教我们修仙？”
“我之前不是给你们说过了吗？你们这群家伙没有灵根，你们这辈子注定只是凡人。”
说话的同时，楚云看向孙悟空。
“让我看看你的灵根！”
楚云伸出手就要抓孙悟空。
孙悟空连连后退。
“那个大王，我知道自己没有灵根，就不用大王劳神费力了。”
随后孙悟空转身风一般的逃走。
楚云冷哼一声。
敢到我这里玩无间道。
刚才对孙悟空说的那些完全都是乱编的。
content_en:
Sun Wukong didn't know that Chu Yun saw all his little moves.
The gap between the two realms is too big.
As soon as Sun Wukong arrived near the stronghold.
Then he was discovered by Chu Yun.
Seeing the minion that Monkey King had transformed into, he walked in with a flattering look on his face.
And the previous Xiaoliuzi.
There is no difference at all.
It seems that Sun Wukong has done this kind of thing a lot in the past.
"What midnight snacks have you prepared today?"
Chu Yun raised his eyelids and glanced at Sun Wukong and asked.
"Your Majesty is roasting chicken today, Lao Baigan!"
Sun Wukong still knows these common people's ordinary fair-weather people.
"Let it go!"
Sun Wukong put down the midnight snack, then rubbed his hands and asked with a smile on his face.
"Your Majesty, you are so skilled. Which school did you study under?"
Although there are not many sects of cultivating immortals in Nanzhan continent.
But in Dongsheng Shenzhou, there are tens of thousands of large and small immortal cultivating sects.
Chu Yun tore off the chicken leg and took a hard bite.
This monkey is obviously trying to make a lie.
Since you dare to ask, I dare to say.
"Did you know that there is a powerful sect in Dongsheng Divine Continent called Qingxuan Sect!"
Qingxuanzong?
Not to mention that Sun Wukong really knows this sect.
When he was in heaven, Sun Wukong heard that Emperor Zhenwu's dojo in the human world was Qingxuan Sect.
It's just that the sect has an order that the disciples of the sect are not allowed to leave Dongsheng Shenzhou without permission.
Therefore, there are not many Qingxuan Sect cultivators in Nanzhan Buzhou and Xiniuhezhou.
"So your Majesty, you are an immortal cultivator from Qingxuan Sect? Then..."
Sun Wukong just wanted to ask Emperor Zhenwu if he is your ancestor.
But he instantly realized that his current identity was nothing more than a little thief.
How would you know about Emperor Zhenwu?
"What then?"
Chu Yun asked.
"I mean, can your Majesty teach us how to become immortals?"
"Didn't I tell you before? You guys have no spiritual roots. You are destined to be just mortals in this life."
While speaking, Chu Yun looked at Sun Wukong.
"Let me see your spiritual roots!"
Chu Yun stretched out his hand to catch Sun Wukong.
Sun Wukong retreated continuously.
"Your Majesty, I know that I don't have spiritual roots, so I don't need your Majesty to bother me."
Then Sun Wukong turned around and ran away like the wind.
Chu Yun snorted coldly.
Dare to come to my place and play Infernal Affairs.
What I just said to Sun Wukong is completely made up.
title_en: Chapter 5 Infernal Affairs and Anti-Infernal Affairs Chapter 6 Being tricked into going to the Zhenwu Dojo for help
